title: SBC Scholarship and Business-Startup Program (S&BSP) Application

meta.title: SBC Scholarship and Business-Startup Program (S&BSP) Application
meta.description: Application for the Strasburg Baptist Church Scholarship and Business-Startup Program (S&BSP).

properties.description:
Strasburg Baptist Church walks beside young members as they enter trades, build family-serving skills, start businesses, or pursue approved college paths.

This application begins the process. After you submit, a board Sponsor may meet with you to understand your request and prepare a support plan for the board.

thankyou_screens.title: Thank you — your application was received

properties.description: A board Sponsor may reach out next to schedule a meeting. Please keep watching your email. If you have questions, contact Strasburg Baptist Church.
